sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently 1st with 22 points, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00) before visiting Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain the league leaders and will look to bounce back against struggling Alsager Town, who sit 19th with just 4 points and have won only once all season. The midweek test against Cheadle Heath Nomads—also in poor form with 7 points—offers Sandbach another opportunity to reassert their title credentials.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) hosting Dawley Town on Saturday before visiting Wednesfield Community the following week, while AFC Bridgnorth (19 points) and Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points) look to close the gap. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community on Saturday in a local derby. In-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir before hosting Crewe. Struggling sides Shawbury United—on a run of six consecutive losses—visit Brereton Social before hosting Alsager Town, while Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) travel to Brereton Social and Market Drayton Town, both needing wins. Telford Town (6 points) visit Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday before hosting New Mills. Market Drayton Town (12 points) face New Mills at home before visiting Widnes Town. Allscott Heath host Brereton Social on 10 October after playing Crewe away. Eccleshall (6th, 18 points) face AFC Bridgnorth at home on Saturday. Barnton travel to Foley Meir before hosting Dawley Town. Sandbach's midweek fixture against Wednesfield Community (13 points) on Wednesday 7 October completes the opening round.
